---
title: "Capability comparison"
description: "How REDCapCDMSTAT relates to existing REDCap tools and packages."
---

REDCapCDMSTAT is not a replacement for the established REDCap packages. It
builds on their ideas and closes the **last mile** between them: data
management and statistics on one audited ledger, with the loop back into
REDCap.

The table compares documented capabilities as of October 2026, based on
each project's CRAN or GitHub documentation and REDCap's own feature set:

- **Yes:** the capability is a documented feature.
- **Partial:** a narrower form, or it needs your own code.
- **—:** not a documented feature.
- **See vendor:** REDCap Cloud's public material does not say; ask nPhase.

Corrections are welcome as
[issues](https://github.com/neu-data/REDCapCDMSTAT/issues).

## The tools compared

| Tool | Type | Focus |
|---|---|---|
| **REDCap (built in)** | Web EDC | Data capture plus Data Quality rules, Data Resolution Workflow, randomisation module, locking and e-signatures |
| **redcapAPI** | R, CRAN | API interface, typed exports and casting, validation of exported values, offline connections |
| **REDCapR** | R, CRAN | API calls in batches, reading and writing, longitudinal and repeating structures |
| **REDCapTidieR** | R, CRAN | Tidy tables from projects with events and repeating instruments |
| **tidyREDCap** | R, CRAN | Helpers: checkbox ("choose all") tables, labels, importing instruments |
| **REDCapDM** | R, CRAN | Data management: transformation, query reports, query follow-up |
| **REDCapSync** | R, CRAN | R6 project object, log-based sync of changed records, cached datasets |
| **RosyREDCap** | R, GitHub | Shiny exploration of several projects, built on REDCapSync |
| **REDCap Cloud** | Commercial SaaS EDC/CDMS | Hosted EDC with randomisation, coding, ePRO/eConsent, 21 CFR Part 11 |
| **REDCapCDMSTAT** | R package + apps + REDCap module | Data management and statistics on one engine, two-way with REDCap |

| Branching logic and calculations evaluated in R | Yes (in REDCap) | — | — | — | — | Yes (converted once) | — | Yes (recompiled from the live dictionary) |
| Studies from other EDCs (CDISC ODM import) | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | Yes |
| Token kept out of code (env, keyring) | n/a | Yes (with rccola) | Partial | Partial | Partial | Partial | Partial | Yes, with a connection check |

## When to use what

- **Quick API scripts, batch exports or imports:** use **REDCapR** or
  **redcapAPI**.
- **Tidy tables for an analysis script:** use **REDCapTidieR** or
  **tidyREDCap**.
- **A cached project object for your own pipelines:** use **REDCapSync**.
  **RosyREDCap** explores several projects.
- **Data-management reports on exported data:** use **REDCapDM**.
- **A fully hosted, vendor-validated commercial EDC/CDMS with ePRO and
  eConsent:** use **REDCap Cloud**.
- **One audited workspace where data managers and statisticians share
  queries, cuts, models and reports, with the loop back into REDCap:** use
  **REDCapCDMSTAT**.

## What REDCapCDMSTAT does not do

- **Participant-facing capture:** no eConsent, ePRO/eCOA or eRecruitment.
  REDCap's surveys and eConsent framework cover these, and their data flow
  in like any form.
- **Native e-signatures:** it does not write e-signatures into REDCap,
  because REDCap's need the signer's REDCap password.
- **Licensed dictionaries:** it does not bundle MedDRA or WHODrug.
- **Live testing:** it has not yet been run against a live REDCap server.
  Run the PQ protocol on a development copy first.
